entry.title: Proof-of-work based signet faucet
entry.summary:
The process of coin claims and payouts within the mining pool is closely monitored through specific addresses that display transaction activities. An example would be observing the activities at [this address](https://mempool.space/signet/address/tb1qxc9rhgpdjcp42nmhg6lepe7pp5g86tx25vlv8h), which helps to track both coins claimed by the pool and subsequent payouts to miners, alongside a 2% reserve held by the pool itself. The payout mechanism employed is based on a geometric scoring method, which inherently delays immediate results as it requires a buildup of scores. These scores only begin to accumulate significance once the contributed coins start being claimed, a process that can also be time-consuming.
Furthermore, if you are identified by [this address](https://mempool.space/signet/address/tb1qzwus45h0fmfsx6uwnpv6uu5tght3808xyhdm4gz7w78vevmhvq2qxun8xl), records indicate a history of approximately 360 solves, with 62 of these resulting in successful coin claims. This activity suggests multiple attempts per coin, where simpler solutions are initially banked for later use before attempting more complex problems that may lead to quicker claims or publications. The total value of the coins solved by you amounts to 58.6 SBTC. Additionally, one specific transaction, detailed at this [link](https://mempool.space/signet/tx/c5984a1ff70be408501c026efdfde7a8c2dae9d00ec0efccaec80898d0422101), appears to be directly associated with one of your solves.
